$comment: Gallery manifest (brief section 8). `release` is the view name step 12 gave it (docs/screenshots/release/<release>-<scheme>.png, written by scripts/screenshots.sh); scripts/site-images.mjs falls back to `standIn` in docs/screenshots/pass-2 only while a release image is missing. Callouts are in source pixels of the 1440x900 image; the visible window is (1440 * 100 / zoom) wide, 16:10, starting at (offsetX, offsetY). Boxes come from site/screenshots.boxes.json (written by the screenshot spec). The two-runs (Compare) view is not in the set: D11 caps the set at 12 images, which is six views in two schemes.

notes: One sentence says where it broke: the step, the time, the tool and the error.
One red line marks the first error. The rows above it stay quiet.
The inspector says what went wrong, from the event itself.
panels.caption: Run page, Timeline tab, first error open. Light and dark follow your system.
panels.alt: A failed run: the headline sentence names the failing step, tool and error, a red line on the timeline marks the first error, and the inspector shows the failed tool call.

notes: A finding is a fixed sentence from a deterministic detector, with its severity.
Show evidence jumps to the exact events it was built from.
panels.caption: Run page, Findings tab. Detectors are rules, not a model.
panels.alt: The Findings tab: three findings, two Critical and one Warning, each with a Show evidence control.

notes: What the period cost, in one sentence, and what a run costs on average.
Where the money was wasted: failed runs, retries and spend after the first error.
Daily spend, one bar per day.
panels.caption: Analytics, Cost. A figure is reported by the provider, computed from tokens and a versioned price, or estimated; an unpriced call counts as $0.
panels.alt: The Cost analytics page: a headline sentence with the week's spend, a block breaking down wasted spend, and a daily spend chart.

panels.sub: One lane per agent, one fault line
notes: The same fault line, drawn vertically across every lane.
The critical path is drawn thicker. A failed span is hatched and marked error.
panels.caption: Run page, Waterfall tab, a scripted multi-agent run.
panels.alt: The waterfall in lanes: one lane per agent on a time axis, the critical path drawn thicker, and a vertical red line at the first error.

notes: A request waits for a person, with its policy version and exact arguments on screen.
The state and the time left, in the list and in the panel.
An approval authorises one action, once, and has an expiry.
panels.caption: Review, Approvals. Policies apply to agents that ask through the SDK guard.
panels.alt: The Approvals page: one pending github.push request in the list, and its detail panel showing that it is waiting, the time left, the policy and the arguments.

notes: A failed run says where it failed and what its retries cost, in the list itself.
Narrow to what needs attention: failed, timed out, blocked, awaiting approval.
The week in one sentence, above the list.
panels.caption: Runs, the project's list.
panels.alt: The runs list: one row per run with its status, agent, start, duration, cost and findings; failed rows state the step they failed at and the retries that followed.
